description: Coordinate, a third-party X status link, a Google Earth link and a Wikipedia link, plus one annotation photo. The two context-host links never count as footage candidates, so the status is the sole candidate and becomes the source; no fixture serves it, so the chase degrades to link-only, and the status id still dates it with no fetch. The Google Earth link becomes a context source of kind satellite titled Google Earth, the Wikipedia link a context source of kind article. No ambiguity is raised.
title: Geolocated 50.412300, 30.512400 warehouse fire
